title: Charlotte's Web
author: E. B. White
summary: A farm runt pig who is saved from slaughter makes friends with a clever barn spider, who sets out to spin messages in her web that might keep him from being killed.
readIf: you want a gentle story about friendship and kindness that still treats loss honestly.
skipIf: you do not want a tear-jerking ending.

pairings.reason: Another classic animal friendship story set in a gentle countryside.
A warm, small-scale friendship story with a similar, soothing feel.
Another animal classic that leans harder into how creatures are treated and lost.
